sources.label: Independent Morphe patches for Discord: attachment file sizes, custom voice mess
sources.author: Venus
patch_list: Account switcher
Switch between multiple Discord accounts from the You tab, your profile bar or Settings.
Alert when you're removed
Get a heads-up when a friend unfriends you, or a server kicks or bans you. Based on RemovedConnectionAlerts by iyu46.
Always trust links and files
Opens links and files without Discord's "Are you sure?" warnings. Based on AlwaysTrust by zt and Trwy.
Anonymous file names
Files you send get a random name instead of the one on your phone. Based on Anonymous File Names by k1ng_op.
Banners in Do Not Disturb
New messages still pop up at the top while you're on Do Not Disturb, without a sound.
Bring back Tenor GIFs
Tenor GIFs show in Discord's GIF picker again, mixed with Discord's own or on their own. Inspired by BringBackTenor by Livie.
Bulk delete messages
Select multiple messages and delete them all at once, in one chat or across channels, servers and DMs.
Clean channel names
Removes emoji and symbols from channel names, and can show spaces instead of dashes.
Clone emojis and stickers
Tap a custom emoji or sticker in chat to add it to one of your servers. Based on ExpressionCloner by Ven.
Complete badges automatically
Plays real PC games in the background, up to 3 at once, toward your Hours Played and Unique Games Played badges.
Complete Quests automatically
Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.
Compress big files
Photos, videos and audio over Discord's file size limit are made smaller to fit as you send them, instead of being refused.
Copy profile bios
Hold a bio to select and copy it.
Custom branding
Installs Venus as its own app next to the normal Discord app, with the name, color and icon you pick. It starts signed out and keeps its own settings. Notifications work in both.
Custom idle time
Choose how long Discord waits before setting you to Idle, or never. Discord's own time is 10 minutes.
Custom themes
Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.
Delete without a trace
Blanks your message before deleting it, so message loggers on other clients keep nothing.
Disable advertising identifiers
Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.
Disable analytics
Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.
Disable crash reporting
Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.
Disable install attribution
Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.
Disable telemetry and touch logging
Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.
Double-tap to reply
Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.
Download voice messages
A Download button under each voice message saves it to your phone. Based on VoiceDownload by puv.
Edit messages on this phone
Hold any message and change how it reads to you. Only you see the change.
Edit servers locally
Give any server your own name and icon. Only you see them. Based on EditServers by mwittrien.
Edit without "(edited)"

Edit a message without the "(edited)" tag. Only works while your message is the latest one in the chat: Venus sends the new text as a new message and deletes the old one. Older messages are edited the normal way.
Expand the message bar
Adds a button to the top right of the message bar that opens it up tall, so you can see much more of what you're typing.
Fake deafen
Look deafened in a call while you can still hear. Choose whether your mic stays muted.
Fast delete channels
Delete a channel without the confirmation, or hold it and tap Delete channel in its menu. Needs Manage Channels. There is no undo.
Favourite any image or video
Star any image or video to keep it in your GIF favourites.
Fix link previews

Links to X, Instagram, TikTok, Tumblr and more show the post. Links you send go through an embed service like FxTwitter, without tracking, and X and Bluesky posts can be translated. Inspired by FixEmbed by the ShiggyCord team.
Fix unknown mentions
@unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.
Full-screen chat in landscape
Chat fills the screen sideways. Swipe from the left for servers and channels.
Hide blocked or ignored messages
Removes the "blocked messages" and "ignored messages" rows from chat, and can hide replies to them too. From Rain.
Hide typing indicator
Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.
HypeSquad house
Join or leave a HypeSquad house (Bravery, Brilliance or Balance) from Venus settings. Discord limits how often you can change house.
Icon packs
Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.
Jump to first message
A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.
Keep Bluetooth audio clear in calls
Headphones stay in music quality in calls. Your phone's mic picks up your voice.
Keep deleted messages
Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.
Keep media playing
Voice messages and audio keep playing when you leave Discord or turn off the screen, and videos pop out into a small window.
Leave group DMs silently
Leave group DMs without the "left the group" message. Based on SilentLeave by coder.gg.
Listen along
Play what a friend is listening to on Spotify, from their profile. Needs Spotify Premium.
Load full-quality images

Pictures in chat and full screen load as uploaded, not as Discord's smaller, compressed copy, and profile pictures stay sharp. Based on Uncompressed Discord Images by Knewest and HighResProfileImages by Kawtious.
Material You colors
Colors Discord to match your wallpaper, in light and dark. Wallpaper colors need Android 12 or newer.
Message highlights
Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.
Mutual group DMs
Profiles show the group DMs you share with that person.
Pastel name colors
Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.
Pause invites
Hold a server's icon to pause its invites until you resume them, to stop a raid. Needs Manage Server.
Platform spoof
Show as desktop, web or console instead of mobile. Discord doesn't allow this and it could put your account at risk. Use at your own risk.
Preview servers without joining
Open a server from its ID or invite link and read it without joining. Based on GuildLurk by fshin.
Read all button
A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.
Remove anything

Tap a button you never use to remove it, right where it is: turn on removal mode, then tap the red X on the voice message, attach, gift, call, video, search, Quests, Shop or Nitro buttons, the Quests banner, attach menu items, message menu…
Reply without pinging
Replies start with the ping off, so nobody gets pinged unless you turn it on.
Send audio as voice messages
Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.
Send long messages
Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.
Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.
Server info
Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.
Show device indicators
Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.
Show file sizes when attaching
Photos and videos in the picker show their size.
Show hidden channels
Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.
Show owner and mod tags
Shows an Owner, Admin, Manager or Mod tag next to people's names in chat. Based on StaffTag by mwittrien.
Show timeout duration
A tag next to timed-out people says how long until they can talk again. Based on ShowTimeoutDuration by Ven.
Skip delete confirmation
Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.
Skip pin confirmation
Pins and unpins messages without asking first. Based on NoConfirmPin by Skamt.
Tap mentions to open profiles
Tap an @mention in the message bar to see who it is. Based on ClickableMentions by mwittrien.
Translate messages
Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.
Unlock app icons
Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.
Unlock Discord experiments
Adds Dev Tools to Settings, to try features Discord is still testing. Only on this phone. Based on Experiments by maisy.
Unlock Nitro themes
Use Discord's gradient themes in Settings > Appearance without Nitro. Only this phone sees them.
Use your phone's emojis
In chat, reactions and the emoji picker, or from an emoji font you import.
Use your phone's font
Replaces Discord's font everywhere with your phone's or one you import. Android 9 or newer.
User activity notifications
Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.
User and server reviews
Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).
Venus button on profile bar
A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.
Venus settings
Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.
View raw data
Hold a message, channel, server, person or role to read its raw data as JSON and copy it. Email and phone number are left out.
Voice channel options
Choose the volume, audio output and sounds for voice channels.

sources.label: Random QoL Patches
sources.author: Seobjects Random
patch_list: Bunny
Revives the Bunny Discord client mod without Xposed or LSPosed.

sources.label: Morphe patches hiding Discord's quest promo banner
sources.author: Discord
patch_list: Hide gift button
Hides the gift button in the chat message composer.
Hide quest promo banner
Hides the quest promo banner at the top of the server channel list.
Pin app to built-in bundle

Forces Discord to always run the bundle inside the APK and ignore downloaded (OTA) updates, which would otherwise silently undo the other patches. Turn this off (or update the APK) to receive official updates.

sources.label: no please don't use this
sources.author: aeong's worthless
patch_list: Block bluetooth hands-free mode
Useful when using bluetooth devices that don't support LE Audio. Be aware that this will use the phone's microphone instead!
